hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southeastern Asia, peninsula bordering Thailand and northern one-third of the island of Borneo, bordering Indonesia, Brunei, and the South China Sea, south of Vietnam || coastal plains rising to hills and mountains || strategic location along Strait of Malacca and southern South China Sea || Resources: tin, petroleum, timber, copper, iron ore, natural gas, bauxite || Exports: integrated circuits, refined petroleum, crude petroleum, natural gas, palm oil (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: coastal plains rising to hills and mountains || Southeastern Asia, peninsula bordering Thailand and northern one-third of the island of Borneo, bordering Indonesia, Brunei, and the South China Sea, south of Vietnam

climate.excerpt: tropical; annual southwest (April to October) and northeast (October to February) monsoons || flooding; landslides; forest fires

economy.excerpt: upper middle-income Southeast Asian economy; implementing key anticorruption policies; major electronics, oil, and chemicals exporter; trade sector employs over 40% of jobs; key economic equity initiative; high labor productivity || Exports: integrated circuits, refined petroleum, crude petroleum, natural gas, palm oil (2023) || Industries: Peninsular Malaysia - rubber and oil palm processing and manufacturing, petroleum and natural gas, light manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, electronics and semiconductors, timber processing; Sabah - logging, petroleum and natural gas production; Sarawak - agriculture processing, petroleum and natural gas production, logging
